age.evidence: Male C57BL/6J mice (7-9 weeks old) were obtained from Japan SLC, Inc. (Hamamatsu, Japan).

sex.evidence: Male C57BL/6J mice (7-9 weeks old) were obtained from Japan SLC, Inc.

dosing.evidence: Psilocin was dissolved to final doses of 1.5, 2.0, and 4.0 mg/kg in 0.9% NaCl solution (saline). All drugs were administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) at a dose of 10 mL/kg.

DOI concentration was adjusted to 10 mg/mL using dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO; Sigma-Aldrich) and dissolved in saline to obtain the final doses of 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 1.0, and 2.0 mg/kg. (DMSO stock diluted in saline.)
The concentration of TCB-2 was adjusted to 10 mg/mL using DMSO and dissolved to final doses of 0.5, 1.0, and 5.0 mg/kg in saline.
Volinanserin was adjusted to 10 mg/mL using DMSO and dissolved in saline to a final dose of 1.0 mg/kg using saline. All drugs were administered intraperitoneally (i.p.)
SB242084 concentration was adjusted to 10 mg/mL using DMSO and dissolved to final doses of 1.0 and 3.0 mg/kg using saline.
The concentration of fluoxetine was adjusted to 50 mg/mL using DMSO and dissolved to a final dose of 10 mg/kg using saline.
The imipramine dose was adjusted to 5.0 mg/kg using saline.

group_housing.evidence: Unless otherwise stated, the mice were group-housed (4-5 mice/cage).

day_night_flipped.evidence: according to a 12-h light/dark cycle (lights on at 7:00 a.m.)

assays.assay_description: Mice placed individually in a clear beaker (19.3 cm high, 13.1 cm diameter) with 15 cm water (25 ± 1 °C) for 15 min; immobility time scored blind from video. Tested 24 h after psilocin/DOI/TCB-2 (dose-response, volinanserin and SB242084 pretreatment, fluoxetine/imipramine comparators), 1 week after dosing, and weekly for 4 weeks after psilocin.

application_type.evidence: All drugs were administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) at a dose of 10 mL/kg.

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice were individually placed in a clear beaker ... at a depth of 15 cm under water ... allowed to swim freely for 15 min (FST cylinder counts as restraint per rubric).

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the water-filled beaker during the 15-min test.

water_restriction.evidence: No drinking water accessible in the beaker during the test.

time_to_assay.evidence: subjected to the FST 24 h after administration ... one week later, they were subjected to the FST ... the FST was repeated every week for a month.

outcomes.summary: Psilocin (1.5 mg/kg), DOI (0.1 and 0.25 mg/kg) and TCB-2 (5.0 mg/kg) decreased FST immobility 24 h post-dose; other doses were ineffective. Effects were blocked by volinanserin but not SB242084. Psilocin's effect persisted for three weeks (not four), whereas DOI and TCB-2 had no effect at one week.
outcomes.evidence: Mice that received psilocin (1.5 mg/kg), DOI (0.1 and 0.25 mg/kg), or TCB-2 (5.0 mg/kg) had significantly decreased immobility time in the FST compared with vehicle-treated control mice. ... psilocin significantly and persistently decreased immobility time for three weeks after administration

B1_num_measures.evidence: The immobility time was measured in a double-blind manner.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only total immobility time per session reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: FST immobility is excluded as ethological per rubric.

B5_social.evidence: Mice were individually placed in a clear beaker

B6_cognitive.evidence: FST is not a learning/memory task.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: All sessions were recorded using a video camera. The immobility time was measured in a double-blind manner.

E1_environment_type.evidence: clear beaker (19.3 cm in height, 13.1 cm in diameter; IWAKI)

E7_social_context.evidence: Mice were individually placed in a clear beaker

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or drinking water in the beaker.

D1_continuity.evidence: To further evaluate how long this effect of psilocin persisted, the FST was repeated every week for a month.

D2_session_duration.evidence: allowed to swim freely for 15 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: FST at 24 h, 1 week, and weekly for a month (weeks 1-4) — ~5 recording days.

D5_followup.evidence: the mice were administered psilocin, DOI, or TCB-2, and one week later, they were subjected to the FST.

assays.assay_description: Mice suspended by the tail (tape 1 cm from tip) in a 30×30×30 cm box at 20 lx for 5 min; immobility time recorded with EthoVision XT 12. Tested 24 h after psilocin/DOI/TCB-2 ± volinanserin pretreatment.

application_type.evidence: All drugs were administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) at a dose of 10 mL/kg.

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice were individually suspended in a tail suspension box ... using a sellotape attached 1 cm from the end of the tail

time_to_assay.evidence: shorter immobility times in the forced swimming test (FST) and tail-suspension test (TST) than vehicle-treated control mice 24 h posttreatment

outcomes.summary: Psilocin (1.5 mg/kg), DOI (0.1 mg/kg) and TCB-2 (5.0 mg/kg) decreased TST immobility 24 h post-dose; volinanserin pretreatment prevented the effect, and volinanserin alone had no effect.
outcomes.evidence: psilocin (1.5 mg/kg), DOI (0.1 mg/kg), and TCB-2 (5.0 mg/kg) decreased the immobility time in the FST and TST, and pretreatment with volinanserin prevented this effect

B1_num_measures.evidence: The immobility time was automatically recorded and analyzed

B4_ethological.evidence: Immobility is not an ethological behaviour.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: analyzed using the Ethovision XT 12 automated tracking program (Noldus) — EthoVision is on SCORE-0 list

E1_environment_type.evidence: tail suspension box (30 cm length x 30 cm width x 30 cm height; BrainScience Idea)

D5_followup.evidence: TST performed 24 h posttreatment (≥24 h after the single dose).

assays.assay_description: Mice food-deprived 24 h, then placed in a brightly lit (100 lx) 31×31×15 cm arena filled with wood-chip bedding with a single food pellet in the centre for 10 min; latency to feed, feeding counts and feeding time scored blind from video. Tested 24 h after psilocin/DOI/TCB-2 ± volinanserin.

application_type.evidence: All drugs were administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) at a dose of 10 mL/kg.

setup_restrain.evidence: Each mouse was placed individually at the center of the apparatus and allowed to move freely in the cage for 10 min.

food_restriction.evidence: Mice were food-restricted for 24 h prior to the NSFT.

water_restriction.evidence: No water source described in the arena during the 10-min test.

time_to_assay.evidence: Mice were subjected to the NSFT 24 h after treatment with psilocin, DOI, or TCB-2.

outcomes.summary: Psilocin reduced latency to feed (anxiolytic-like), an effect not attenuated by volinanserin; DOI and TCB-2 did not affect latency. TCB-2 increased feeding count and feeding time; psilocin and DOI did not.
outcomes.statistics: latency: H(6) = 21.70, p = 0.00090; feeding count: H(6) = 14.83, p = 0.011 (TCB-2 vs vehicle p < 0.001); feeding time: H(6) = 17.69, p = 0.0034 (TCB-2 vs vehicle p < 0.0001)
outcomes.evidence: Psilocin treatment significantly reduced the latency to feed (Fig. 3a), which was not attenuated by pretreatment with volinanserin ... In contrast, DOI or TCB-2 administration did not affect the latency to feed in the NSFT.

B1_num_measures.evidence: The latency to feed, feeding counts, and feeding time data of each mouse were collected in a double-blind manner.

B4_ethological.evidence: feeding counts, and feeding time — feeding acts directly scored from video.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: recorded using a video camera ... collected in a double-blind manner (manual scoring)

E1_environment_type.evidence: bright light (100 lx) arena (31 cm long × 31 cm wide × 15 cm heigh)

E2_shelter.evidence: Open, brightly lit arena; no shelter described.

E3_bedding.evidence: arena ... filled with wood chip bedding material

E7_social_context.evidence: Each mouse was placed individually at the center of the apparatus

E8_food_water.evidence: A single food pellet was placed in the center of a bright light (100 lx) arena

D1_continuity.evidence: allowed to move freely in the cage for 10 min

D5_followup.evidence: Mice were subjected to the NSFT 24 h after treatment (≥24 h after the single dose).

assays.assay_description: Mice placed in an observation cage (29×18×12 cm, 15 lx) immediately or 24 h after psilocin/DOI/TCB-2; HTR counted manually and blind from 30-min video recordings.

application_type.evidence: All drugs were administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) at a dose of 10 mL/kg.

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice were placed in an observation cage (29 cm long × 18 cm wide × 12 cm heigh); no restraint described.

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the observation cage.

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the observation cage.

time_to_assay.evidence: Mice were placed in an observation cage ... immediately or 24 h after drug administration.

outcomes.summary: Psilocin (1.5 mg/kg), DOI (1.0 or 2.0 mg/kg) and TCB-2 (5.0 mg/kg) increased HTR immediately after injection; DOI 0.1 mg/kg did not induce HTR. No HTR increase was seen 24 h after any compound.
outcomes.evidence: Mice showed significantly greater HTR immediately after treatment with psilocin (1.5 mg/kg), DOI (1.0 or 2.0 mg/kg), or TCB-2 (5.0 mg/kg) ... psilocin (1.5 mg/kg), DOI (0.1 mg/kg), or TCB-2 (5.0 mg/kg) did not affect the HTR in mice 24 h after treatment

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total HTR count over 30 min only.

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR excluded as ethological per rubric.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: The HTR was recorded for 30 min using by a video camera ... counted ... in a double-blind manner (manual).

E1_environment_type.evidence: observation cage (29 cm long × 18 cm wide × 12 cm heigh)

E3_bedding.evidence: No bedding mentioned for the observation cage.

E7_social_context.evidence: Mice were placed in an observation cage (individually).

D1_continuity.evidence: we investigated HTR for 30 min either immediately or 24 h after treatment (two recording timepoints, likely separate cohorts).

D2_session_duration.evidence: The HTR was recorded for 30 min

assays.assay_description: Three-chamber apparatus (62×41×22.5 cm; three 21×41 cm chambers with cut-out doors) with wire cages; consecutive 15-min habituation (empty cages), sociability (stranger1 vs empty) and social novelty (stranger2 vs stranger1) sessions, 24 h after psilocin/DOI/TCB-2. Interaction times measured with EthoVision XT 12; sociability and social novelty indices calculated.

application_type.evidence: All drugs were administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) at a dose of 10 mL/kg.

setup_habituation.evidence: During habituation, the subject mouse was allowed to habituate to the apparatus and freely explore the three chambers for 15 min.

setup_restrain.evidence: The subject mouse was introduced into the central chamber and allowed to freely explore the three chambers for 15 min.

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the three-chamber apparatus.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in the three-chamber apparatus.

time_to_assay.evidence: The mice were subjected to the test 24 h after treatment with psilocin, DOI, or TCB-2.

outcomes.summary: All groups preferred stranger1 over the empty cage, with no group differences in interaction time or sociability index. In the social novelty session, vehicle mice preferred stranger2 over stranger1 while psychedelic-treated mice did not, although between-group differences in stranger2 interaction time and social novelty index were not significant.
outcomes.statistics: Habituation: vehicle W=-42.00, p=0.25; psilocin W=-7.00, p=0.56; DOI W=-12.00, p=0.46; TCB-2 W=-10.00, p=0.47. Sociability: vehicle W=120.00, p<0.0001; psilocin W=21.00, p<0.05; DOI W=36.00, p<0.01; TCB-2 W=36.00, p<0.01; stranger1 time H(4)=5.29, p=0.15; sociability index H(4)=2.19, p=0.53. Social novelty: vehicle W=112.0, p<0.001; psilocin W=17.00, p=0.0938; DOI W=22.00, p=0.15; TCB-2 W=18.00, p=0.25; stranger2 time H(4)=4.62, p=0.20; social novelty index H(4)=2.68, p=0.44
outcomes.evidence: These results suggest that mice treated with or without psychedelics showed the same level of sociability. ... even though the vehicle-treated control mice exhibited social novelty/discrimination, the mice treated with psychedelics did not show such behavior.

B1_num_measures.evidence: The time spent interacting with stranger1, stranger2, and the empty cage was automatically measured ... 'sociability index' ... social novelty index

B4_ethological.evidence: The time spent interacting with stranger1, stranger2 ... (social investigation of conspecifics), though measured via EthoVision proximity.

B5_social.evidence: an unfamiliar male C57BL/6J mouse (stranger1) ... was placed in a wire cage in the left chamber

B6_cognitive.evidence: A three-chamber sociability test was used to assess sociability and interest in social novelty and discrimination (social recognition).

B7_automated_classification.evidence: automatically measured using the Ethovision XT 12 automated tracking program (Noldus) — SCORE-0 list

E3_bedding.evidence: No bedding mentioned in the apparatus.

judge_notes: All three candidates identified the same six assays (FST, TST, NSFT, HTR, three-chamber, locomotor activity); no merging or dropping was needed. FST variants (dose-response, volinanserin/SB242084 pretreatment, fluoxetine/imipramine, 1-week and weekly long-term tests) are collapsed into one FST assay.

B1 corrected for FST, TST, HTR and locomotor to score 0 (single measure = 0 points); candidates gave inconsistent score/value pairs. For NSFT, 3 measures gives '2-3' = 1 point; candidates had scored 2. For the three-chamber test, 5 measures (3 interaction times + 2 indices) gives '4-6' = 2.
FST D2 set to 1 (15 min falls in 15–60 min; gemma scored 0). FST D3 set to 2-7 (about 5 recording days: 24 h, 1 wk, weekly to 4 wk); deepseek's 8-14 was inconsistent with its own count of 5 days.
Locomotor D2 set to 1 (15 min is inclusive in 15–60 min; gemma scored 0).

D5 set to Yes for TST, NSFT, three-chamber and locomotor. All were tested 24 h after a single dose, which meets the ≥24 h criterion. This overrides the candidates for consistency with the modal HTR 24-h scoring.
Three-chamber D4 overridden to No. The habituation session occurred 24 h after drug administration, so it is not a pre-drug baseline.
Three-chamber D1 (Multiple) and B6 (Yes) follow the modal candidate values. B4 is kept as Yes per modal, at medium confidence, because interaction time is EthoVision proximity-based.
HTR D1/D3/D5 follow the modal candidate values (two timepoints: immediately and 24 h).
FST setup_restrain set to 'yes' per rubric, which explicitly lists the FST cylinder (gemma had 'no').

Added dosing entries for the non-psychedelic co-administered drugs (volinanserin, SB242084, fluoxetine, imipramine), as the rubric asks for every compound administered. The DMSO stock for DOI and TCB-2 was diluted in saline, so the vehicle is recorded as saline.
DOI normalised to the bare identifier 10.21203/rs.3.rs-3138705/v1 (Research Square preprint, posted July 2023).
